source_note: Target: Rosstat oblast grain yield (Regions of Russia / tochno-st 13120000), sown-area-weighted by zone (Krasnodar·Rostov·Stavropol / Belgorod·Voronezh·Kursk·Tambov). Basket is cereals+legumes (winter-wheat dominated in these oblasts). Crimea/new regions excluded. Weather: NASA POWER + GWETROOT; Open-Meteo T/P forecast tails only (no OM soil).
methodology_note: Log technology trend + ridge weather residual. Skill from forward chaining with trend refit inside each fold. Features: autumn recharge, winter bare-frost / winterkill proxies, April GWETROOT, spring precip, grain-fill EDD (28 °C).

skill.method: forward chaining, trend refit inside each fold, scored on recent folds
skill.uncertainty_basis: out-of-sample RMSE over last 10 forward folds

provenance.label_source: Rosstat Regions of Russia (tochno-st 13120000) Krasnodar+Rostov+Stavropol; sown-area weights 13050000; 2024 from mojgorod yearbook table
provenance.region_share: Southern Federal District + Stavropol export winter-wheat belt; oblast labels exclude Volga/Siberia spring wheat dilution.
provenance.caveat: Target: Rosstat oblast grain yield (урожайность зерновых, c/ha→kg/ha), sown-area-weighted within the zone. Indicator is cereals+legumes (not winter-wheat-only); in South/CBE winter wheat dominates that basket. Crimea/new regions excluded. ERA5-Land snow optional; without it winterkill uses POWER Tmin bare-frost. No Open-Meteo soil (project rule).
provenance.non_weather_drivers: Russian wheat yields carry a strong post-Soviet recovery and variety trend, plus fertilizer and policy shocks (export duty regime). Those are not weather; the log technology trend absorbs the smooth part, not the policy steps.
